requirement.evidence: Housing providers receiving Department of Neighborhood Development (DND) funding and/or land, or that have income restricted units created under the Boston Planning and Development Agency (BPDA) Inclusionary Development Policy will not impose a blanket policy that denies housing to anyone with arrests and or convictions. Housing providers will consider applicants on a case-by-case basis.
requirement.note: Blanket-ban prohibition, case-by-case review and the four excluded categories are stated. The 5-year exclusion is qualified: the policy does not apply where there is a direct relationship between the conviction and the housing or unreasonable risk of harm, and not to current criminal behavior. The card omits these exceptions. The tenant tip about asking for review and offering rehabilitation evidence is only loosely supported (rehabilitation is a factor landlords consider; an appeals process only 'when feasible').
